name: calibre-mcp
description: The most capable Calibre MCP server — full read/write tool surface plus library- and book-scoped semantic search.
long_description: Connect Claude to your local Calibre library through the Calibre Content Server. Search by metadata or full text, read book content in chunks, find duplicates, audit metadata quality, and recover real metadata for raw-filename books via Open Library / Google Books. Writes (update, bulk update, add, remove) are disabled by default and require both the Enable writes toggle and a Calibre server started with --enable-local-write. Semantic (meaning-based) search requires the optional embeddings dependency and is available via the npm install (npx calibre-mcp); this bundle ships without it to stay small — keyword and full-text search work out of the box.

server_url.title: Calibre Content Server URL
server_url.description: Where the Calibre Content Server is listening. Start it in Calibre: Connect/share → Start Content server.

library.title: Library
library.description: Calibre library name. Leave empty to use the server's default library automatically.

enable_write.title: Enable writes
enable_write.description: Allow tools that modify the library (update/bulk-update/add/remove). Also requires running the Calibre server with --enable-local-write; the server embedded in the Calibre GUI is read-only.

index_dir.title: Search index directory
index_dir.description: Where the local search index is stored. Leave empty for the platform default data directory.

calibredb_path.title: calibredb binary
calibredb_path.description: Path to the calibredb executable. Leave empty to auto-detect the standard Calibre install location.

add_roots.title: Folder books may be imported from
add_roots.description: calibre_add_book only imports files under this folder. Leave empty for the default (Documents + Downloads).

use_coverflow.title: Coverflow search results
use_coverflow.description: Show search results as a 3D cover flow instead of the default scrolling cover shelf.

tools.name: calibre_search
tools.description: Find books by title, author, ISBN, tag, Calibre query syntax, or full text; library- or book-scoped

tools.name: calibre_get_book
tools.description: Full metadata, formats, and cover link for one book

tools.name: calibre_get_content
tools.description: Read a book's text as capped, cursor-walkable excerpts

tools.name: calibre_list_categories
tools.description: Browse tags, authors, series, and custom columns with counts

tools.name: calibre_list_libraries
tools.description: List the libraries the Content Server exposes

tools.name: calibre_semantic_search
tools.description: Meaning-based search (hybrid vector + keyword), across the library or inside one book

tools.name: calibre_build_index
tools.description: Build the local semantic/keyword index for selected books

tools.name: calibre_find_duplicates
tools.description: Find duplicate book groups with merge-safety scoring

tools.name: calibre_quality_report
tools.description: Audit metadata quality: missing fields, raw filenames, invalid ISBNs, series gaps

tools.name: calibre_recover_metadata
tools.description: Propose real metadata for raw-filename books via Open Library / Google Books (preview-only, never writes)

tools.name: calibre_update_book
tools.description: Set metadata fields on one book (write-gated)

tools.name: calibre_bulk_update
tools.description: Apply the same metadata changes to a set of books, preview-first (write-gated)

tools.name: calibre_add_book
tools.description: Import a local ebook file into the library, path-whitelisted (write-gated)

tools.name: calibre_remove_book
tools.description: Permanently delete books — records and files; requires confirm (write-gated)

tools.name: calibre_ping
tools.description: Health check for the Calibre connection
